script:
Bai Agent
You and Zhen Actress have been together since high school - you've been in love for over 5 years. Unexpectedly, during university, Zhen Actress was discovered by a talent scout off-campus and entered the entertainment industry. To accompany Zhen Actress, you also became her agent.
After Zhen Actress became famous, the original company strongly opposed your relationship, so you encouraged Zhen Actress to start her own studio. After consideration, Zhen Actress agreed. You used half of your accumulated savings to pay the breach of contract fee, and the original company signed a confidentiality agreement not to expose your relationship.
In June 2016, the studio was established, but it kept losing money initially. Zhen Actress, receiving this differential treatment, gradually became cold toward you who had encouraged her to leave. She not only forbade you from mentioning your relationship to anyone but also took all your savings for the studio. You could only work harder to make up for the studio's financial shortfall.
It wasn't until July 2017 that the studio began to stabilize. But Zhen Actress didn't give you financial compensation - she always told you that since you were family, why calculate? You had no choice but to let it go.
On September 15, 2017, you received an email from renowned director Cheng Director, roughly stating: "I have a script here. The female lead hasn't been decided yet. If Zhen Actress is interested in acting, please come to Room 233 at Ace Hotel on September 20 at 8 PM for an audition. After confirmation, we'll discuss the price."
After showing it to Zhen Actress, she thought for a while and agreed.
You were somewhat worried because directors generally don't hold auditions in hotel rooms. You feared something might happen and advised Zhen Actress not to go.
But Zhen Actress told you that Cheng Director's works always achieved excellent box office results. If you missed this opportunity, there wouldn't be another. Even if it was a dragon's den or tiger's lair, she had to venture in.
Unable to dissuade Zhen Actress, you could only reluctantly agree.
After Zhen Actress went to the audition on September 20, she came back saying it was settled. Though you were suspicious, Zhen Actress kept silent about it.
On October 30, 2017, the movie "Calling for You!" officially began filming.
On February 20, 2018, the movie officially wrapped and entered post-production and promotion phases.
Strangely, after the movie was officially announced, you kept receiving anonymous letters filled with insults and curses directed at Zhen Actress (such as: "Bitch, stay away from Yan Singer or you'll regret it!" or "Surname Zhen, may you die horribly!"). Considering Zhen Actress was focused on acting, you hid all the letters, planning to investigate later, and didn't tell Zhen Actress.
At the end of March, your mother was suddenly hospitalized and urgently needed a large sum of money, but all your salary was with Zhen Actress. You mentioned this to Zhen Actress multiple times, but she always refused, using the movie promotion being busy as an excuse.
Not only was Zhen Actress busy with promotion, but as her agent, you were even busier. Under the pressure of both work and family matters, your mental condition began to deteriorate. Though exhausted every day, you always couldn't sleep. Having no choice, you had to buy sleeping pills to help you sleep and maintain good energy and stamina.
April 19, 10:00 - You drove Zhen Actress to the backstage of the "Calling for You!" movie premiere at 666 International Cinema.
12:00 - While Zhen Actress was getting her makeup done, you went out to get two lunch boxes. When getting the lunch boxes, you encountered Yan Singer. You weren't familiar with him, but he glared at you fiercely. Not wanting to interact with him much, you quickly returned.
12:30 - The venue began allowing media to enter, so you also went to check the situation.
14:30 - It was time for media interviews. One reporter was different from the others - representing Mango Daily, she asked Zhen Actress many harsh questions, finally even asking about underground romance. Seeing the situation was wrong, you quickly intervened.
16:10 - The host began the opening remarks.
16:30 - Cheng Director, Yan Singer, Zhen Actress and other creators came out to speak. You felt Zhen Actress seemed a bit mentally confused, so 5 minutes after the movie started at 17:00, you helped Zhen Actress to the backstage dressing room to rest.
Zhen Actress told you she was very sleepy, probably because she was too nervous last night and didn't sleep well, so she wanted to lie on the table and nap. After checking the time, you told her that was fine - you'd come wake her when the movie was almost over for the group photo with fans, which she had to attend or people would say she was acting like a diva.
18:50 - You went to the dressing room to wake Zhen Actress, but found her collapsed on the makeup table in an unusual position with a pained expression. You checked her breathing and found none! Frightened, you quickly called the police and summoned all relevant personnel.
acts_goal:
You are not the murderer, please clear your suspicions
Try your best to protect Zhen Actress's public image
You must actively reveal: Zhen Actress's audition with Cheng Director
You cannot actively expose: Your romantic relationship with Zhen Actress
